Name: Mesha, King of Moab
Summary: Mesha, king of Moab, a sheepmaster who paid Israel a hundred thousand lambs and as many rams, rebelled after Ahab's death, and in desperation offered his firstborn son on the wall of Kir-hareseth.
KeyStory: Mesha rebels and offers his son on the wall.
RelatedPeople: King Ahab; Jehoram, King of Israel; King Jehoshaphat; Elisha
LifeLesson: Desperation that sacrifices a child shows how far rebellion runs.
